# Faceless Video Pro - llms.txt

> Free local prompt-to-commercial pipeline. 1 prompt becomes a 20s vertical MP4. Python plus BYO Pexels key plus optional BYO LLM plus EdgeTTS plus FFmpeg.

- Repo: https://github.com/dnislno/faceless-video-pro
- Setup: pip install -r requirements.txt; cp .env.example .env; fill PEXELS_API_KEY and optional LLM_API_KEY, LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_MODEL
- Run: python generate_ad.py --prompt "Korean lipstick, 3 dollars, viral TikTok ad"
- Input: product ad brief in plain English, for example "Iced brown sugar latte, 4 dollars"
- Output: output/*.mp4, 1080x1920, max 20s, H.264 plus AAC, no burned captions by default
- Stack: requests (Pexels API portrait), edge-tts (default en-US-AriaNeural), ffmpeg (scale, crop, concat, mux)
- Cost: $0 with free tiers plus offline template; LLM optional (OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Groq, Ollama at http://localhost:11434/v1)
- Full agent guide: DEPLOY_FOR_LLM.md
- License: MIT. Pexels footage under the Pexels license.
- Keywords: faceless video generator, AI commercial video maker, TikTok video automation, Pexels API, EdgeTTS free text to speech, FFmpeg Python
